The '''skirmish at the Endor shield bunker''' was a battle in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], the Galactic Empire, and a legendary creature known as the [[Griagh]] as part of the [[Imperial-Ewok War]], which led to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] [[4 ABY/Legends|eight months later]].<ref name="Shadows of Endor" />
